scripts.build: rm -rf dist       ; tsc       && mkdir -p dist/src       && cp -r src/resources dist/src/resources       && mkdir -p dist/src/private/eric/ERiC-43.4.6.0       && cp -r src/private/eric/ERiC-43.4.6.0/Linux-x86_64 dist/src/private/eric/ERiC-43.4.6.0/
scripts.start:image: op run --env-file .env -- docker run -p 3000:3000 -e ERIC_HERSTELLERID -e FIT_CONNECT_ENV -e FIT_CONNECT_CLIENT_ID -e FIT_CONNECT_CLIENT_SECRET -e FIT_CONNECT_DESTINATION_ID -e FIT_CONNECT_PUBLIC_KEY_ENCRYPTION_JWK -e FIT_CONNECT_PRIVATE_KEY_DECRYPTION_JWK unternehmen-steuer-gewerbe
scripts.start:watch: op run --env-file .env -- nodemon --watch . --ignore dist --ext ts,json,json5,yml,md --exec pnpm run start
